title: Hisense 85" UR9SAU RGB 4K MiniLED 180Hz TV 2026 $2,485 (via Price Check) + Delivery from $59 @ The Good Guys
body:
Deal: Hisense 85" UR9SAU RGB 4K MiniLED 180Hz TV 2026 $2,485 (via Price Check) + Delivery from $59 @ The Good Guys

[silverathlon1] Not a huge difference but $2485 with price beat!
[JoeyJoeJoe] That $10 could be the clincher for many. Personally, I’m on the fence. Not sold on miniLED versus LG OLED.
[Arkhxm] Think of it as $10 off delivery.
Also really depends on your set up. If you’re mostly watching TV at night then OLED is the way. If you’re mostly watching in bright room or during the day with curtains up, mini led better.
[p3r514n] Depends what you watch. If we use sport for example like a ice hockey rink, the ABL on an OLED will shit itself whereas MiniLED will blitz it. They're simply better for bright content and bright environments and as such. On the other hand, OLED is better for dark environments. I converted from OLED to Mini LED and haven't looked back.
[teereb] Also, the price, like Mini LED is far far cheaper. I have MiniLED for a few years, still wouldn't convert me to OLED. I'm not that price limited either, but I don't throw money away.
Even in dark environment, yes OLED can switch of pixels, but even MiniLED will get under 1 nit in brightness. My point, not worth the extra $.
[goblues31] Hold for TCL C8L which I assume will hit this price soon..?
[Opaquer] My TV died recently so I'm looking for a new TV. It's been a bit since I last looked - I don't think we want a full OLED so something like this would be good. I've also heard good things about the TCL line (C7L and C8L) but I'm not sure how they would stack up to this one?
Alternatively are there any TVs that people recommend too? We're probably looking for a 75", though if a 85" is about this price we wouldn't be against it either!
[RaijnAU] It always looks smaller after using it a week.
[Opaquer] That's very true! Our old old tv was about 42", and we upgraded to a 75" when it died and thought that was insane. Now that this one has died, we're not against an 85" if it's got what we want out of it and is a good price :P
[Shiroi Okami] Why not 110", its only slightly bigger :)
[Opaquer] @Shiroi Okami: That might be a little too much! I don't even think that'll fit onto the wall where we want it!
[laydownyourtongs] Does Hisense run Android Tv now or still their own shitty OS?
[Coops1] Price error for sure. This is a 65" sale price. Bargain
[Megahowler] Absolutely cracking price… I paid the same for the 85U85AU about a month ago..
Only negative I've heard about these first gen RGB mini LEDs is a bit of backlight colour bleeding
[Nunubuffs] Do I buy or no? Price is insane. I was thinking C6 or C8L but seeing this at this price? Help
[Nunubuffs] Missed out :( lesson learnt, buy now, think later.
[thatguyfromthatplace] I jumped on it immediately and got one, now I'm worried. I hope they honour it.
[p3r514n] I'm keen to know if they honour it. Please let us know.
[JakeHC] I tried contacting JB-HiFi to get them to price match with the $1050 gift card and they told me it was a pricing error. Came back to The Good Guys and the listing is gone.
[p3r514n] Insane price. This is retailing for 7k everywhere else.
